test_int_byteswap: test the int_byteswap function with uint16, uint32, and uint64 types across read offsets and byteswap flags
test_float_byteswap: test the float_byteswap function with float32 and float64 types across read offsets and byteswap flags
test_read_uint16_with_byteswap: test the read_uint16_with_byteswap function to read and swap a 16-bit unsigned integer from byte data
test_read_uint32_with_byteswap: test the read_uint32_with_byteswap function to read and swap a 32-bit unsigned integer from byte data
test_read_uint64_with_byteswap: test the read_uint64_with_byteswap function to read and swap a 64-bit unsigned integer from byte data
